headline: How to Get Somniwing
title: How to Get Somniwing in Aniimo | Elite Training Reward | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Searching the map for Somniwing? Stop! Somniwing never appears in the wild, so you will not find it anywhere. It is a reward from Elite Training. Complete one hundred and eighty Elite Training objectives, then talk to Doctor Lewis at the Outpost to get it. Every Elite Training tab counts toward the same score, so just keep clearing objectives. Do you have Somniwing yet? Comment below!
description: How to get Somniwing in Aniimo: it does not spawn in the wild - complete 180 Elite Training objectives and talk to Dr. Lewis at the Outpost.
